text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Mijene se događaju zato što je osvijetljena samo ona strana Venere (ili Mjeseca) okrenuta prema Suncu. Venerine mijene idu u prilog Kopernikovoj teoriji da se planeti kreću oko Sunca.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Potom je nekoliko godina kasnije, 1639., engleski astronom Jeremiah Horrocks uočio Venerin tranzit.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Ako posjetite Grenland tijekom hladnih mjeseci (uzmite u obzir da je klima sve hladnija što putujete sjevernije), neophodno je ponijeti dovoljno toplu odjeću.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Dugo trajanje dana ljeti može uzrokovati neispavanost i povezane zdravstvene tegobe.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Tijekom ljeta treba se paziti i nordijskih komaraca. Iako nisu prijenosnici bolesti, mogu biti iritantni.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Iako je gospodarstvo San Francisca povezano s činjenicom da je svjetska turistička atrakcija, njegovo je gospodarstvo raznovrsno.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Najveći su sektori zapošljavanja uslužne djelatnosti, državna uprava, financije, trgovina i turizam.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Često pojavljivanje u glazbi, filmovima, književnosti i popularnoj kulturi grad i njegove znamenitosti proslavilo je diljem svijeta.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco razvio je veliku turističku infrastrukturu koja uključuje brojne hotele, restorane i vrhunska mjesta za održavanje kongresa.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Isto tako, San Francisco jedno je od najboljih mjesta u državi za azijsku kuhinju: korejsku, tajlandsku, indijsku i japansku.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Put u Walt Disney World mnogim američkim obiteljima predstavlja veliko hodočašće.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Tipični posjet uključuje let do Međunarodne zračne luke Orlando, vožnju autobusom do Disneyjeva hotela na licu mjesta, boravak u trajanju od tjedan dana bez napuštanja Disneyjeva imanja i povratak kući.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: "Moguće su beskonačne varijacije na tu temu, no to je i dalje ono na što ljudi misle kad govore o ""posjetu Disney Worldu""."
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Brojne ulaznice koje se prodaju online preko aukcijskih web-lokacija kao što su eBay ili Craigslist djelomično su korištene ulaznice za višednevni posjet parkovima.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Iako se radi o vrlo uobičajenoj aktivnosti, Disney je zabranjuje: ulaznice nisu prenosive.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Za svako kampiranje izvan obruča Grand Canyona potrebna je dozvola.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Dozvole su ograničene u svrhu zaštite kanjona, a stavljaju se na raspolaganje prvog dana u mjesecu, odnosno četiri mjeseca prije mjeseca početka.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Prema tome, dozvole za kampiranje za bilo koji datum u svibnju dostupne su od 1. siječnja.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Slobodna mjesta za najpopularnija područja, poput kampa Bright Angel blizu ranča Phantom, obično se popune već prvog dana otvaranja mogućnosti rezervacija.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: "Broj dostupnih dozvola za osobe koje se prijavljuju na licu mjesta ograničen je i funkcionira prema načelu ""tko prvi, njegovo""."
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ulazak u Južnoafričku Republiku automobilom odličan je način da vidite sve ljepote regije kao i da dođete na mjesta koja nisu na uobičajenim turističkim rutama.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: To se može učiniti u običnom automobilu pažljivim planiranjem, ali preporučuje se 4 x 4, a i mnoge su lokacije dostupne samo automobilima s velikim međuosovinskim razmakom od 4 x 4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Prilikom planiranja ne zaboravite da je južni dio Afrike stabilan, ali i da to nije slučaj za sve susjedne države.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Uvjeti i troškovi vize razlikuju se od države do države, a ovise i o državi iz koje dolazite.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Svaka zemlja ima jedinstvene zakone u kojima je navedeno koja oprema za prvu pomoć mora biti u automobilu.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls je grad u zapadnom dijelu Zimbabwea, preko granice kraj Livingstona u Zambiji i u blizini Botswane.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Grad se nalazi neposredno pored slapova, a oni su najveća atrakcija, no ova popularna turistička atrakcija onima u potrazi za pustolovinom i posjetiteljima pruža brojne prilike za duži boravak.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: U kišnoj sezoni (od studenog do ožujka), količina je vode veća, pa slapovi izgledaju dramatičnije.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Zasigurno ćete se namočiti ako prijeđete most ili pješačite stazama u blizini vodopada.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: S druge strane, zbog velike količine vode u tom razdoblju nećete moći dobro vidjeti same slapove jer će vam smetati... voda!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Tutankamonova grobnica (KV62). KV62 je vjerojatno najpoznatija grobnica u Dolini i poprište je otkrića gotovo netaknutog mjesta svečanog ukopa mladog kralja koje je Howard Carter otkrio 1922.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: U usporedbi s većinom kraljevskih grobnica, Tutankamonovu jedva da vrijedi posjetiti jer je puno manja i ima malo ukrasa.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Svi zainteresirani za dokaze oštećenja nastalih na mumiji tijekom pokušaja izvlačenja iz lijesa bit će razočarani s obzirom da se mogu uočiti samo glava i ramena.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Nevjerojatna bogatstva grobnice više se tamo ne nalaze, već su premještena u Egipatski muzej u Kairu.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Posjetiteljima s ograničenim vremenom preporučuje se da vrijeme provedu negdje drugdje.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km jugozapadno od Siem Reapa. Hram na brdu izgrađen je krajem 9. stoljeća za vladavine kralja Yasovarmana.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Sumorna atmosfera hrama i pogled na jezero Tonle Sap ono su što penjanje na brdo čini vrijednim truda.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Posjet lokaciji može se praktično kombinirati s putovanjem brodom na jezero.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Da biste ušli u hram, potrebna vam je propusnica za Angkor pa nemojte zaboraviti ponijeti putovnicu kada se zaputite u Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jeruzalem je glavni i najveći grad Izraela iako ga većina drugih zemalja i Ujedinjeni narodi ne priznaju kao glavni grad Izraela.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Antički grad u judejskim brdima ima fascinantnu povijest koja obuhvaća tisuće godina.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Grad smatraju svetim tri monoteističke religije – judaizam, kršćanstvo i islam, a služi kao duhovno, vjersko i kulturno središte.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Budući da Jeruzalem, posebice mnoga nalazišta na području Starog grada, ima vjerski značaj, jedno je od glavnih turističkih odredišta u Izraelu.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jeruzalem ima mnoštvo povijesnih, arheoloških i kulturnih znamenitosti te živahne i krcate trgovačke centre, kafiće i restorane.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekvador zahtijeva da građani Kube prime pisanu pozivnicu prije ulaska u Ekvador u međunarodnim zračnim lukama ili na graničnim prijelazima.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Ministarstvo vanjskih poslova Ekvadora mora legalizirati pismo koje mora biti u skladu s određenim zahtjevima.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ti zahtjevi postavljeni su radi organiziranog migracijskog toka između dviju zemalja.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Građani Kube koji imaju zelenu kartu SAD-a moraju posjetiti ekvadorski konzulat kako bi dobili izuzeće od ovog zahtjeva.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Vaša putovnica mora vrijediti najmanje 6 mjeseci nakon datuma vašeg putovanja. Karta za kružno/daljnje putovanje potrebna je za dokazivanje duljine boravka.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Izleti su jeftiniji za veće grupe pa ako ste sami ili ako je s vama samo jedna osoba, pokušajte upoznati druge ljude pa formirajte skupinu od četiri do šest osoba kako biste platili manju cijenu po osobi.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: No zapravo vas to ne bi trebalo brinuti jer se turiste često preslaguje da bi se popunila vozila.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Čini se da je riječ o načinu na koji se ljude pokušava prijevarom uvjeriti da moraju platiti više.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ta strma planina uzdiže se nad sjevernim rubom Machu Picchua, a često se pojavljuje kao pozadina na fotografijama ruševina.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Izgleda zastrašujuće odozdo i radi se o strmom i teškom usponu, ali osobe s normalnom kondicijom trebale bi se moći uspeti u približno 45 minuta.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Duž većine staze postavljene su kamene stube, a na strmijim dijelovima čelični kabeli služe kao drške za ruke.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: S obzirom na sve navedeno, očekujte gubitak daha i pazite na strmijim dijelovima, posebno ako je mokro jer brzo postaje opasno.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Blizu vrha nalazi se mala špilja kroz koju trebate proći, a koja je poprilično niska i uska.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Razgledavanje lokaliteta te biljnog i životinjskog svijeta Galapagosa najbolje je učiniti brodom, baš poput Charlesa Darwina 1835. godine.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Preko 60 kruzera krstari vodama Galapagosa s po 8 do 100 putnika.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Većina ljudi rezervira svoje mjesto puno unaprijed (s obzirom da su brodovi obično popunjeni u visokoj sezoni).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Uvjerite se da je agent putem kojeg vršite rezervaciju stručnjak za Galapagos i da je dobro upoznat s mnogobrojnim vrstama brodova.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Na taj način zajamčit ćete odabir najprikladnijeg broda u skladu s vašim određenim interesima i/ili ograničenjima.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Prije dolaska Španjolaca u 16. stoljeću, sjevernim Čileom vladale su Inke dok su autohtoni Araukanci (Mapuče) nastanjivali centralni i južni Čile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Pleme Mapuche bilo je i jedno od posljednjih neovisnih američkih starosjedilačkih zajednica koje nije u potpunosti prihvatilo španjolski jezik do proglašenja nezavisnosti Čilea.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Premda je Čile proglasio neovisnost 1810. (usred napoleonskih ratova zbog kojih je Španjolska nekoliko godina bila bez centralne vlade), odlučna pobjeda nad Španjolcima dogodila se tek 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominikanska republika (španjolski: República Dominicana) karipska je država koja zauzima istočnu polovicu otoka Hispaniola, koji dijeli s Haitijem
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Osim bijelih pješčanih plaža i planinskih krajolika, u njoj se nalazi i najstariji europski grad u Sjevernoj i Južnoj Americi, koji je sada dio Santo Dominga.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Otok su prvo nastanili pripadnici plemena Taíno i naroda Karibi. Narod Karibi govorio je aravačkim jezikom i stigao na otok oko 10 000 godina prije Krista.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: U roku od nekoliko godina nakon dolaska europskih istraživača, španjolski osvajači značajno su smanjili populaciju Taino
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Prema djelu Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias), španjolski su osvajači između 1492. i 1498. godine ubili oko 100 000 pripadnika plemena Taíno.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Prostor je izgrađen kao atrij za samostan iz 17. stoljeća, a jedina preostala građevina je Templo de San Diego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Sada funkcionira kao središnji trg i uvijek se na njemu mnogo toga događa, danju i noću.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Brojni restorani okružuju vrt, a poslijepodne i uvečer besplatni koncerti održavaju se u središnjoj sjenici.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Aleja poljupca). Dva balkona razmaknuta samo 69 centimetara dom su stare ljubavne legende.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: U zamjenu za nekoliko novčića, neka djeca ispričat će vam priču.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Otok Bowen predstavlja popularno odredište za dnevni izlet ili vikend-odmor koje nudi mogućnosti vožnje kajacima i planinarenja, kao i trgovine, restorane i više.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Ova jedinstvena zajednica nalazi se u Howe Soundu blizu Vancouvera i lako je dostupna vodenim taksijem koji redovno isplovljava s otoka Granville u donjem Vancouveru.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Svi koji uživaju u aktivnostima na otvorenom ne smiju propustiti pješačenje koridorom Sea to Sky.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 sati vožnje od Vancouvera) skup je no poznat zahvaljujući Zimskim olimpijskim igrama iz 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Zimi uživajte u jednom od najboljih skijaških doživljaja u Sjevernoj Americi, a ljeti isprobajte autentični brdski biciklizam.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Potrebno je ishoditi dozvolu unaprijed. Morate imati dozvolu da biste prenoćili u Sireni.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena je jedina stražarnica koja nudi smještaj i obroke uz prostor za kampiranje. La Leona, San Pedrillo i Los Patos nude samo kampiranje bez obroka.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Parkirne dozvole moguće je pribaviti izravno u rendžerskoj postaji u Puerto Jiménezu, no ne prihvaćaju kreditne kartice
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Služba parka (MINAE) ne izdaje dozvole više od jednog mjeseca prije predviđenog dolaska.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol nudi uslugu rezervacije uz naknadu od 30 američkih dolara ili 10 američkih dolara za jednodnevne propusnice. Pojedinosti na njihovoj stranici za Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Cookovi otoci otočna su država, samoupravno područje Novoga Zelanda koje se nalazi u Polineziji, usred južnog Pacifičkog oceana.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Radi se o arhipelagu s 15 otoka koji se prostiru na 2,2 milijuna km2 oceana.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Budući da se nalaze u istoj vremenskoj zoni kao Havaji, otoci se ponekad nazivaju „Autstralskim Havajima”.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Premda su manji, starije posjetitelje podsjećaju na Havaje prije stjecanja državnosti, samo bez velikih hotela i ostalih zdanja.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Na Cookovom Otočju nema gradova, ali sastoji se od 15 različitih otoka. Glavni su Rarotonga i Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: U razvijenim zemljama danas, ponuda luksuznog noćenja s doručkom dovedena je na gotovo umjetničku razinu.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: U osnovi, ugostiteljski objekti koji nude noćenje i doručak natječu se uglavnom u dvjema stvarima: noćenju i doručku.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Sukladno tome, u najboljim takvim objektima može se naći najluksuznija posteljina, možda ručno izrađeni prekrivač ili antikni krevet.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Doručak može uključivati sezonske delikatese iz tog područja ili specijalitet domaćina.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Dugo putovanje u vlastitom automobilu suštinski je privlačno zbog jednostavnosti koju to sa sobom nosi.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Za razliku od većih vozila, vjerojatno ste već upoznati s vožnjom svojeg automobila i znate njegove granice.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Za pridruživanje takvoj mreži obično treba ispuniti online obrazac, iako neke mreže nude ili zahtijevaju dodatnu provjeru.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Tada se dobije popis dostupnih domaćina u ispisanom obliku i/ili putem interneta, ponekad s referencama i recenzijama drugih putnika.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Stranicu Couchsurfing osnovao je programer Casey Fenton 2004. godine kad je kupio kartu jeftinog leta za Island, ali nije imao smještaj.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Poslao je e-poruku studentima na lokalnom sveučilištu i dobio iznimno velik broj ponuda za besplatan smještaj.

text: Grad Peking u Kini bit će domaćin Zimskih olimpijskih igara 2022., čime će postati prvi grad koji je ugostio i ljetne i zimske olimpijske igre.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Peking će biti domaćin ceremonije otvaranja i zatvaranja te dvoranskih natjecanja na ledu.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Ostala skijaška događanja održat će se na skijalištu Taizicheng u mjestu Zhangjiakou, oko 220 km (140 milja) od Pekinga.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Većina hramova održava godišnji festival koji započinje krajem studenoga i traje do sredine svibnja, no to ovisi o godišnjem kalendaru hrama.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Većina svetkovina u hramu slavi se u sklopu obljetnice hrama ili rođendana božanstva kojem je hram posvećen ili nekog drugog velikog događaja povezanog s hramom.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Festivali u hramovima Kerale vrlo su zanimljivi, a uključuju redovite povorke ukrašenih slonova, svirke u hramovima i druge svečanosti.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Svjetski sajam (često se naziva i Svjetska izložba ili jednostavno Izložba) veliki je međunarodni festival umjetnosti i znanosti.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Zemlje sudionice u nacionalnim paviljonima postavljaju umjetničke i edukativne izložbe s ciljem demonstracije globalnih pitanja ili kulture i povijesti vlastite zemlje.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Međunarodne izložbe hortikulture su specijalizirani događaji na kojima se prezentiraju cvjetni aranžmani, botanički vrtovi i sve ostalo što ima veze s biljkama.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Iako se u teoriji mogu održavati jednom godišnje (sve dok se odvijaju u različitim zemljama), u praksi to nije tako.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Postoje različiti formati filma koji su se upotrebljavali godinama. Najuobičajeniji je standardni film od 35 mm (negativ dimenzija 36 puta 24 mm).
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Možete poprilično jednostavno obnoviti zalihe ako vam ponestane filma, a rezolucija je približno usporediva s onom digitalnog zrcalno-refleksivnog fotoaparata.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Neke filmske kamere srednjeg formata primjenjuju format 6 x 6 cm, točnije negativ dimenzija 56 x 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: To pruža gotovo četiri puta veću razlučivost od 35-milimetarskog negativa (3136 mm2 u odnosu na 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Divlja priroda među najizazovnijim je motivima za fotografa i za nju je potrebna kombinacija sreće, strpljenja, iskustva i dobre opreme.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Fotografija divljine često se uzima zdravo za gotovo, ali poput fotografije općenito, slika vrijedi tisuću riječi.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Za fotografije divlje prirode često je potreban dugačak telefoto objektiv premda su za objekte poput jata ptica ili sitnih bića potrebni drugi objektivi.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Mnoge egzotične životinje teško je pronaći, a u parkovima ponekad postoje pravila o fotografiranju u komercijalne svrhe.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Divlje životinje mogu biti sramežljive ili agresivne. Okruženje može biti hladno, vruće ili na drugi način nepristupačno.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: U svijetu ima preko 5000 različitih jezika, a više od dvadeset njih ima preko 50 milijuna ili više govornika.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Često cijele nacije tečno govore engleski jezik, a u još većem broju država možete očekivati ograničeno znanje, posebno među mlađom populacijom.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Zamislite stanovnika Manchestera, Bostona, Jamajke i Sydneya kako sjede za stolom u restoranu u Torontu i večeraju .
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Časte se pričama iz rodnog grada, na svojim naglascima i lokalnom žargonu.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kupnja hrane u samoposlugama obično je najjeftiniji način prehrane. Bez mogućnosti kuhanja, izbor je ograničen na gotovu hranu.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Sve više supermarketa nudi raznovrsniji odjel gotove hrane. Neki čak imaju mikrovalnu pećnicu ili druga sredstva za zagrijavanje hrane.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: U nekim zemljama ili u nekim vrstama trgovina barem jedan restoran nalazi se unutar prostora trgovine, a taj je restoran često prilično neformalan i cijene u njemu su pristupačne.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Na kopijama se treba vidjeti adresa e-pošte osiguravatelja i međunarodni telefonski brojevi za savjetovanje/odobrenje i podnošenje zahtjeva.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Ako putujete s prijenosnim računalom ili tabletom, pohranite kopiju u memoriju ili na disk (kojem možete pristupiti i kad nemate pristup internetu).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Kopije pravila/kontakta uručite suputnicima i rodbini ili prijateljima kod kuće koji su voljni pomoći.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Losovi (ili jeleni) sami po sebi nisu agresivni, ali branit će se ako uoče prijetnju.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Ako ljudi ne smatraju losa potencijalno opasnim, mogu mu se previše približiti i izložiti se riziku.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Alkoholna pića konzumirajte umjereno. Alkohol na svakoga djeluje drukčije i vrlo je važno da znate gdje vam je granica.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Moguće dugoročne zdravstvene posljedice prekomjernog pijenja mogu uključivati oštećenje jetre te sljepilo i smrt. Potencijalne opasnosti rastu od konzumacije nezakonito dobivenog alkohola.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Ilegalna žestoka pića mogu sadržavati razne opasne nečistoće, uključujući metanol, koji može uzrokovati sljepoću ili smrt čak i u malim dozama.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Naočale su ponekad jeftinije u stranim državama, osobito u zemljama s niskim prihodima u kojima su troškovi radne snage niži.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Razmislite o pregledu očiju kod kuće, posebno ako za to imate osiguranje te uzmete recept da se potvrdi drugdje.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Okviri luksuznih marki dostupni u takvim područjima nose dva moguća problema: neki su možda kopije, a pravi uvezeni okviri mogu biti skuplji nego kod kuće.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kava je jedan od najtraženijih svjetskih proizvoda, a vjerojatno mnoge vrste postoje i u vašoj regiji.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Bilo kako bilo, postoje brojni načini ispijanja kave diljem svijeta koje vrijedi doživjeti.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Kanjoning (ili canyoning) je put do dna kanjona, koji može biti suh ili ispunjen vodom.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Kanjoning (eng. canyoning) kombinira elemente plivanja, penjanja i skakanja, a da biste se upustili u tu aktivnost, potrebno vam je relativno malo obuke i tjelesne spreme (u usporedbi s,  primjerice, sportskim penjanjem, ronjenjem ili alpskim skijanjem).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Planinarenje je aktivnost na otvorenom koja se sastoji od pješačenja u prirodi, često po planinarskim putovima.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Jednodnevno planinarenje uključuje udaljenosti manje od kilometra do većih udaljenosti koje se mogu prijeći u jednom danu.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Za dnevni izlet laganom stazom nije potrebno puno priprema, a u njima može uživati bilo koja osoba u prosječnoj formi.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Za obitelji s malom djecom potrebno je više pripreme, no dan na otvorenon moguć je čak i uz dojenčad i predškolsku djecu.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Na međunarodnoj razini postoji gotovo 200 turističkih organizacija za trčanje. Većina ih radi neovisno.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Nasljednik organizacije Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours, sadrži desetke pružatelja usluga trčanja uz razgledavanje na četiri kontinenta.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Vuče korijene iz organizacija Running Tours Barcelona iz Barcelone i Running Copenhagen iz Kopenhagena, a tu je i Running Tours Prague sa sjedištem u Pragu i druge organizacije.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Mnogo je stvari potrebno uzeti u obzir prije i tijekom putovanja.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Na putovanjima ne očekujte da stvari budu „kao kod kuće”. Običaji, zakoni, hrana, promet, smještaj, standardi, jezik i ostalo u određenoj se mjeri razlikuju od onih kod kuće.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: To je nešto što biste uvijek trebali imati na umu da biste izbjegli razočaranje ili čak gađenje prema lokalnim načinima postupanja.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Putničke agencije postoje još od 19. stoljeća. Putnički agent obično je dobra opcija za putovanje koje izlazi iz granica putnikovog dotadašnjeg iskustva s prirodom, kulturom, jezikom ili zemljama s niskim primanjima.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Iako je većina agencija voljna preuzeti većinu redovnih rezervacija, mnoge agencije specijalizirane su za određene vrste putovanja, jeftina putovanja ili destinacije.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Bolja je mogućnost angažirati agenta koji redovito rezervira putovanja slična vašem.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Pogledajte kakve izlete agent promovira, bilo na web-lokaciji ili u izlogu.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Ako želite jeftino putovati oko svijeta, bilo iz nužde, zbog životnog stila ili kao izazov, postoje načini na koje to možete učiniti.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: U osnovi spadaju u dvije kategorije: ili radite dok putujete ili pokušajte srezati troškove. Ovaj se članak bavi potonjim.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Za one koji su voljni žrtvovati udobnost, vrijeme i predvidljivost da bi troškove sveli na nulu, pogledajte putovanja s minimalnim troškovima.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Savjet predviđa da putnici ne kradu, ne provaljuju, ne sudjeluju na ilegalnom tržištu, ne prose niti na drugi način koriste druge u vlastitu korist.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Imigracijska kontrolna točka obično je prva točka nakon iskrcaja s aviona, broda ili drugog vozila.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: U nekim se prekograničnim vlakovima kontrola provodi kad je vlak u pokretu, pa sa sobom valja imati vrijedeću osobnu iskaznicu prilikom ukrcaja.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Da bi vam se zajamčio neprekinut san, u noćnim vlakovima sa spavaćim kolima putovnice može prikupljati kondukter.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Registracija je dodatni preduvjet za postupak dobivanja vize. U nekim zemljama morate prijaviti prisutnost i adresu na kojoj odsjedate lokalnim vlastima.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Možda ćete trebati ispuniti obrazac lokalne policije ili posjetiti imigracijski ured.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: U mnogim državama u kojima je takav zakon na snazi, lokalni hoteli obavit će registraciju (pobrinite se da pitate za to).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: U ostalim slučajevima, moraju se registrirati samo oni koji odsjedaju izvan turističkog smještaja. Međutim, zbog toga je zakon još nejasniji, stoga se raspitajte unaprijed.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arhitektura se bavi nacrtima i gradnjom građevina. Arhitektura mjesta često je turistička atrakcija za sebe.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Mnoge su građevine zaista oku ugodne, a pogled s visoke zgrade ili pametno postavljenog prozora može doista oduzeti dah.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arhitektura se značajno preklapa s drugim poljima, uključujući urbanističko planiranje, građevinarstvo, primijenjene umjetnosti, dizajn interijera i krajobrazni dizajn.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: S obzirom na to koliko su udaljeni mnogi zaselci, nećete pronaći značajan noćni život bez putovanja u Albuquerque ili Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Provjerite detaljne zahtjeve s ustanovom i uredom za useljenike za državu u kojoj želite studirati.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Osim ako ste diplomat, rad u prekomorskim zemljama obično podrazumijeva prijavu poreza na dohodak u zemlji u kojoj boravite.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Porez na dohodak različito je strukturiran u različitim zemljama, a porezne stope i razredi uvelike variraju od jedne do druge zemlje.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: U nekim saveznim državama, kao što su Sjedinjene Države i Kanada, porez na dohodak skuplja se na saveznoj i lokalnoj razini, stoga se stope i razredi mogu razlikovati ovisno o regiji.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Iako granične provjere obično izostaju ili su puka formalnost kad ulazite u svoju domovinu, carinska kontrola može biti gnjavaža.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Svakako provjerite što možete, a što ne možete unijeti i prijavite sve iznad zakonskih ograničenja.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Najjednostavniji način da počnete pisati o putovanjima je da izbrusite vještine na postojećoj stranici ili blogu o putovanjima.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Kad naučite formatirati i uređivati objave na web-stranicama, možete i napraviti svoju stranicu.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Volontiranje tijekom putovanja odličan je način da nešto promijenite u svijetu, no ne radi se samo o davanju.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Život i volontiranje u stranoj državi izvrstan je način upoznavanja druge kulture i novih ljudi, učenja o sebi, stjecanja nove perspektive pa čak i učenja novih vještina.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: To može biti i dobar način da se rastegne budžet za dulji ostanak negdje budući da mnogi volonterski poslovi nude smještaj i hranu, a neki plaćaju i malu naknadu.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikinzi su koristili ruske plovne putove kako bi došli do Crnog mora i Kaspijskog jezera. Dijelovi tih ruta i dalje se koriste. Provjerite jesu li potrebne posebne dozvole, koje može biti teško dobiti.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Kanal između Bijelog i Baltičkog mora povezuje Arktički ocean s Baltičkim morem preko Oneškog, Ladoškog jezera i Sankt Peterburga, uglavnom preko rijeka i jezera.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Jezero Onega povezano je i s Volgom pa je plovidba Kaspijskim jezerom kroz Rusije i dalje moguća.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Budite sigurni da jednom kada dođete u marinu, sve će biti poprilično očito. Upoznat ćete druge slijepe putnike na brodu koji će podijeliti informacije s vama.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Uglavnom postavljate obavijesti u kojima nudite pomoć, šećete pristaništima, pristupate ljudima koji čiste svoje jahte, pokušavate razgovarati s mornarima u baru, itd.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Pričajte sa što je više ljudi moguće. Nakon nekog vremena svi će vas poznavati i uputiti vas na brod na kojemu traže ljude.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Trebate pažljivo odabrati zračnu luku u savezu za program Frequent Flyer za osobe koje često lete.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Iako možda mislite da je prirodno pridružiti se zrakoplovnoj kompaniji s kojom najčešće letite, imajte na umu da se ponuđene povlastice često razlikuju te da možete primiti više nagradnih bodova za česte putnike od druge zrakoplovne kompanije iz istog udruženja.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Zračni prijevoznici kao što su Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways i Turkish Airlines uvelike su proširili svoje usluge u Africi i nude povezanost s mnogim velikim afričkim gradovima po kompetitivnim cijenama u odnosu na druge europske prijevoznike.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Zrakoplovi aviokompanije Turkish Airlines od 2014. godine lete u 39 destinacija u 30 afričkih zemalja.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Ako imate na raspolaganju dodatno vrijeme za putovanje, provjerite ukupnu cijenu puta u Afriku u usporedbi s cijenom puta oko svijeta.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ne zaboravite uračunati troškove izrade dodatnih viza, poreza za odlazak iz zemlje, zemaljskog prijevoza itd. za sve lokacije izvan Afrike.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Ako želite obići svijet zrakoplovom putujući u cijelosti južnom polutkom, odabir letova i odredišta ograničen je zbog nedostatka prekooceanskih ruta.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Međutim, Star Alliance pokriva sve osim istočnog južnog Pacifika od Santiaga de Chile do Tahitija jer je to domena zrakoplovne kompanije LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Azerbejdžanska regija Nagorno-Karabah u kojoj žive etnički Armenci 1994. je povela rat protiv Azera.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Uz podršku Armenije stvorena je nova republika. Međutim, niti jedna država, pa čak ni Armenija, nije ju službeno priznala.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Diplomatske nesuglasice po pitanju regije i dalje narušavaju odnose između Armenije i Azerbejdžana.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Kanalska četvrt (nizozemski: Grachtengordel) poznata je četvrt iz 17. stoljeća koja okružuje Binnenstad u Amsterdamu.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Cijela je četvrt na popisu UNESCO-ve svjetske baštine radi svoje jedinstvene kulturne i povijesne vrijednosti, a vrijednosti nekretnina među najvišima su u zemlji.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: "Cinque Terre, što znači ""Pet zemalja"", naziv je za pet malih priobalnih naselja u talijanskoj regiji Liguriji: Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza i Monterosso."
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Nalaze se na popisu svjetske baštine UNESCO-a.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ljudi su stoljećima brižno gradili terase na neravnom, strmom terenu sve do litica koje se nadvijaju nad morem.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Dio šarma je i u nedostatku vidljivog komercijalnog razvoja. Sela su povezana stazama, vlakovima i čamcima te se do njih ne može doći izvana automobilom.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Inačice francuskog jezika koje se govore u Belgiji i Švicarskoj neznatno se razlikuju od francuskog koji se govori u Francuskoj, no dovoljno su slične da se njihovi govornici mogu međusobno razumjeti.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Konkretno, u brojčanim sustavima u Belgiji i Švicarskoj gdje se govori francuski postoje razlike od francuskog koji se govori Francuskoj i izgovor pojedinih riječi pomalo se razlikuje.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Ipak, svi Belgijanci i Švicarci koji govore francuski vjerojatno su učili standardni francuski u školi pa bi vas mogli razumjeti čak i ako koristite standardni francuski brojevni sustav.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: U mnogim je dijelovima svijeta mahanje prijateljska gesta pozdrava.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Međutim, u Maleziji, barem među Malezijcima u ruralnim područjima, to znači „dolaziti”, slično kao kažiprst savijen prema tijelu – gesta koja se upotrebljava u određenim zapadnim zemljama i trebala bi se upotrebljavati samo u tu svrhu.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Slično tome, britanski turist u Španjolskoj može protumačiti mahanje u znak oproštaja dlanom okrenutim prema onome tko maše (umjesto prema onome kome se maše) kao gestu za povratak.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Pomoćni jezici su umjetni ili konstruirani jezici stvoreni s namjerom olakšavanja komunikacije među osobama koje bi inače imale poteškoća u komuniciranju.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Nisu isto što i lingua franca, odnosno prirodni ili organski jezici koji iz različitih razloga postanu dominatno sredstvo komunikacije između govornika drugih jezika.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Za vrućih dana putnici mogu doživjeti fatamorgane koje daju iluziju vode (i drugog).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: To može biti opasno ako putnik odluči poći za fatamorganom te na to potroši dragocjenu energiju i preostalu vodu.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Čak i najtoplija pustinja može noću postati iznimno hladna. Pothlađenost je stvarna opasnost ako nemate tople odjeće.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ljeti treba posebno pripaziti na komarce ako krenete u hod kroz prašumu.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Čak i dok vozite kroz suptropsku prašumu, dovoljno je da vrata otvorite na nekoliko sekundi dok ulazite u vozilo kako bi u njega ušli i komarci.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Ptičjom gripom ili formalnije influencom ptica mogu se zaraziti i ptice i sisavci.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Manje od tisuću slučajeva prijavljeno je kod ljudi, ali neki od njih su bili smrtonosni.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Većina je uključivala ljude koji rade s peradi, ali bilo je i određenog rizika za osobe koje promatraju ptice.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Za Norvešku su tipični strmi fjordovi i doline koje iznenada prelaze u visoke, više-manje jednake visoravni.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: "Ove visoravni često se nazivaju ""vidde"", što znači širok, otvoren prostor bez drveća, prostranstvo bez granica."
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: "U okruzima Rogaland i Agder obično se nazivaju ""hei"", što znači močvarni predio bez drveća najčešće pod vrijesom."
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Ledenjaci nisu stabilni, već teku niz planinu. To može uzrokovati pukotine i provalije koje mogu biti prikrivene snježnim nasipima.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Zidovi i krovovi ledenih spilja mogu se srušiti i pukotine se mogu zatvoriti.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Na rubu ledenjaka ogromni se dijelovi mogu odvojiti, pasti te možda pomaknuti ili otkotrljati dalje od ruba.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Međutim, brdske stanice odlikuju se različitom vrstom ljepote i šarma tijekom zime. Mnoge od njih tada su prekrivene pristojnim količinama snijega i nude aktivnosti kao što su skijanje i daskanje na snijegu.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.
